port.ask: Serial port the shaker's RS-232 socket (right side of the control panel) is cabled to
port.help: Linux /dev/ttyUSB0 (or /dev/serial/by-id/...), macOS /dev/tty.usbserial-*, Windows COM3. Use a straight DB-9 cable or a USB-to-RS-232 adapter.

baud.ask: Baud rate selected on the shaker's RS232/COMM screen (9600, 19200 or 38400; factory 19200)
